findings.summary: SourceInfo is built from the stale identifier `total_bitrate_mbps`, which the diff removed — this fails to compile.
findings.mechanism: Earlier in the same function the diff replaced `let total_bitrate_mbps = ...` with `container_bps`/`video_bps`/`video_bitrate_mbps`, but line 340 still writes `video_bitrate_mbps: total_bitrate_mbps`. `total_bitrate_mbps` is no longer in scope, so `cargo build` fails with an unresolved-name error; even if it somehow resolved, it would discard all the new video/audio-bitrate logic and reintroduce the exact bug (#311) the change was meant to fix.
